Text Clause(s) CONTRACT FOR HIRING OF AMBULANCE, DEPARTMENTAL CAR & VI P CAR ON HIRING BASIS AT ASP SCOPE OF WORK 1. SCOPE OF WORK The Contractor shall provide the following vehicles on hiring basis for official and departmental use of Stee l Authority of India Ltd., Alloy Steels Plant, Durgapur, during the entire contract period: Sl. No. Description of Vehicle Quantity 1. Ambulance 01 No. 2. Departmental Car 01 No. 3. VIP Car 01 No. All the vehicles shall be provided in good condition, roadworthy condition and suitable for the intended pur pose throughout the contract period. The vehicles shall have valid commercial registration and shall comply with all applicable statutory require ments. 2. SPECIFICATION OF VEHICLES A. AMBULANCE – 01 No. The Contractor shall provide 01 (one) No. Ambulance having the following minimum specifications: Model Maruti Eco / Mahindra Supra Fuel Type Petrol Operated Colour White Minimum Required Features The Ambulance must have the following facilities: 1. Factory-fitted AC. 2. Provision for keeping Oxygen Cylinders at a suitable position/place from where the cylinders can be o perated easily and comfortably. 3. Provision for hanging saline bottle by suitable hook from the roof. 4. Provision for First Aid Box and Fire Extinguisher. 5. Folding stretcher for carrying bed-ridden patients. 6. One Wheel Chair. 7. Patient bed/stretcher arrangement with provision for moving wheels, so that sufficient length of the b ed can be taken out of the ambulance by sliding movement while shifting patients.

8. Proper seating arrangement for one attendant beside the patient, from where the attendant can provi de the required care conveniently and comfortably. 9. The Ambulance shall be maintained in a clean, hygienic and serviceable condition at all times. The above specifications are based on the existing Ambulance scope. B. DEPARTMENTAL CAR – 01 No. The Contractor shall provide 01 (one) No. Departmental Car having the following minimum specifications: Model MarutiDzire / Honda Amaze / Toyota Etios. Fuel Type PETROL Operated A.C CAR-FACTORY FITTED A.C Colour White Minimum Required Features The Car shall be equipped with: l Power windows. l Good quality and clean seat covers. l Steering wheel cover. l Floor Mats. l Operational Music System. l Spare Wheel. l Complete and suitableset of tools. l First Aid Box. l Other necessary tools and tacklesrequired for normal operation and maintenance of the vehicle. l Tyre's and tubes, horn, headlights, side lights, brakes and rear-view mirrors shall be maintained in good working condition at all times. l The vehicle shall be maintained in proper, clean, hygienic and roadworthy condition throughout the contr act period. C. VIP CAR – 01 No. The Contractor shall provide 01 (one) No. VIP Car having the following minimum specifications: Vehicle Type White Colour Diesel AC Car – Factory Fitted AC Model The model of the VIP Car may be: · MarutiErtiga (VDI/VXI) · Mahindra Marazzo (M4 PLUS) · Hyundai Creta E The vehicle shall be in good condition and suitable for VIP duty. The model for which the price quoted is lowest, shall be considered for evaluation of the L-1 tender, as app licable.

Other Requirements · The vehicle shall be factory-fitted with AC. · The vehicle shall be provided with experienced drivers who are physically and mentally fit in all respe cts. · The vehicle shall be maintained in proper, clean, hygienic and roadworthy condition throughout the c ontract period. · All necessary consumables, lubricants, tools & tackles and other requirements for maintenance of the vehicles shall be arranged as per the terms and conditions of the contract. The above model and basic requirements are retained from the existing VIP Car scope. 3. REGISTRATION & AGE OF VEHICLES The registration date of the vehicles shall be as follows: · Ambulance:Registration date shall not be before 01/01/2024. · Departmental Car: Registration date shall not be before 01/01/2024. · VIP Car: Registration date shall not be before 01/01/2024. The maximum running distance of each vehicle at the time of deployment shall not be more than 36,000 k m. All vehicles shall have commercial number plates. 4. VALID DOCUMENTS & STATUTORY REQUIREMENTS All vehicles deployed on duty shall possess valid: · Commercial Registration Certificate. · Comprehensive Insurance Policy, including coverage of occupants. · Fitness Certificate. · Pollution Under Control Certificate. · Road Tax. · Permit. · Any other statutory documents required under the applicable Central/State Government rules. All such documents shall remain valid throughout the contract period. The Contractor shall ensure timely renewal of all documents before their expiry. One copy of all relevant d ocuments shall be handed over to the Traffic Department, and one copy shall be kept in the respective ve hicle. 5. DUTY HOURS & DEPLOYMENT A. Ambulance & Departmental Car The Ambulance and Departmental Car shall be available for round-the-clock duty, i.e. 24 hours per day an d 7 days per week, throughout the contract period. B. VIP Car The VIP Car shall normally be available for duty from8:00 AM to 10:00 PM (14 hours) plus 2 hours of midnig ht duty, which may be utilized either in the morning or in the evening as required. In case of exigency or outstation movement, the driver may be required to perform duty beyond the specif ied working hours. Extra charges for such additional duty hours shall be payable at the applicable rate spe cified in the tender. Normal working hours for each driver shall be 08 hours per day. Drivers shall be required on all weekdays, including Sundays and Holidays, as per requirement. 6. USE OF VEHICLES The vehicles shall be used exclusively for the official/departmental purposes of SAIL, Alloy Steels Plant, Du

rgapur during the contract period. The Ambulance and Departmental Car shall normally be used within the Durgapur Notified Area. However, the vehicles may occasionally be required to perform outstation duties in emergency cases. No additional payment shall be admissible for such outstation journeys wherever covered under the applic able terms and conditions of the contract. The VIP Car shall be used by Senior Executives of SAIL/ASP, Durgapur for local as well as outstation move ment, including stay beyond normal duty hours and night halt during outstation movement. The approximate monthly running of the VIP Car shall be 1400 km. 7. DRIVER REQUIREMENT The Contractor shall provide suitably experienced and competent drivers for the VIP Car as required under the contract. The drivers shall be: · Experienced. · Physically and mentally fit. · Possessing valid driving license and other applicable documents. · Compliant with all applicable labour laws and statutory requirements. Engagement of drivers shall be governed by the relevant labour laws applicable from time to time. 8. RUNNING, REPAIR & MAINTENANCE The Contractor shall be responsible for keeping all vehicles in proper running and roadworthy condition. The Contractor shall bear the applicable expenditure towards: a) Statutory payments required for operation of the vehicles. b) Repair and maintenance of vehicles. c) Lubricants. d) Consumables. e) Necessary tools and tackles. f) Spare parts and other materials required for smooth running of the vehicles. g) Insurance. h) Driver wages and other applicable driver-related expenses. The Contractor shall ensure that all vehicles remain in good working condition throughout the contract per iod. 9. DEPLOYMENT OF VEHICLES The Contractor shall place the vehicles at the disposal of such officers or authorities as may be directed by the Executing Authority or representative of the User Department within 07 (seven) days from the date of r eceipt of Work Order, or within such period as may be advised by the Company. 10. ROAD-WORTHINESS OF VEHICLES All vehicles shall be maintained in roadworthy condition throughout the working hours. In case of any difference of opinion regarding the roadworthiness or otherwise of any vehicle between the Contractor/Contractor's representative and the concerned Officer/Authority to whom the vehicle reports for duty, the decision of the User Department shall be final and binding on the Contractor. 11. BREAKDOWN / NON-AVAILABILITY OF VEHICLE In case of breakdown of any vehicle or non-availability of any vehicle for more than one day, for any reaso n whatsoever, the Contractor shall arrange an alternative/substitute vehicle of similar type at his own resp onsibility. The substitute vehicle shall meet the required specifications and shall be acceptable to the User Departme nt.

12. LOSS / DAMAGE TO VEHICLES The Company shall have no responsibility for any loss or damage caused to the vehicles by destruction or otherwise for any reason whatsoever. The Contractor shall adequately cover such risks by obtaining comprehensive insurance policies and shall take full responsibility in all such matters. 13. CONTRACTOR'S OFFICE The Contractor must have his own office at Durgapur or within a radius of 60 km from Durgapur, since at l east one year priorto the commencement of the contract. 14. MATERIALS TO BE SUPPLIED BY CONTRACTOR The materials to be supplied by the Contractor shall include lubricants, consumables, spare parts and othe r necessary materialsrequired for smooth and trouble-free running of the vehicles as per the contract. 15. ENGAGEMENT OF DRIVERS The Contractor shall be responsible for engagement and deployment of drivers as required for the vehicles covered under the contract. All matters relating to engagement of drivers shall comply with the relevant labour laws and statutory prov isions applicable from time to time. 16. CONTRACT PERIOD The contract shall be awarded for a period of TWO (02) YEARS commencing from the date of placement of the Work Order. 17. EXECUTING AUTHORITY GM (Traffic), Alloy Steels Plant, Durgapur or his authorized representative shall be the Executing Authority for this contract. CONTRACT PERIOD: TWO (02) YEARS 3.
